Regulations 4F. (1) The Minister may make regulations

(2) Every regulation made by the Minister
shall be published in the Gazette and shall come
into operation on the date of such publication
or on such later date as may be specified in
such regulation.
(3) Every regulation made by the Minister,
shall within a period of three months after its
publication in the Gazette, be brought before
Parliament for approval. Any regulation which
is not so approved, shall be deemed to be
rescinded as from the date of such disapproval,
but without prejudice to anything duly done
thereunder.
(4) A Notification of the date of disapproval
shall be published in the Gazette.
